title: Linnaeus' expedition to Lapland
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Linnaeus' expedition to Lapland", at revision 1350339291, opens: "The expedition to Lapland, the northernmost region in Sweden, by Carl Linnaeus between May and October 1732 was an important part of his scientific career." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q5420971, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "expedition by Carl Linnaeus in 1732". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
